data.name: About_Disclaimer
data.value: PrettyDesk is an independent fan project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by any game publisher. All wallpapers are original artwork inspired by games, never copies of official art.

data.name: About_PrivacyBody
data.value: No telemetry. No accounts. PrettyDesk only contacts its own content server to download wallpapers and updates, and your list of running programs never leaves your PC.
